title: Tester: every page renders for admin and employee
interface: A pytest module using the fixtures app, client and helper login from tests/conftest.py and helper api. Seed one employee and one asset through the API (Authorization: Bearer test-api-key). Assert: as admin (admin@firma.cz) GET /admin/assets, /admin/assets/new, /admin/assets/<id>, /admin/assets/<id>/edit, /admin/handovers, /admin/employees, /admin/employees/jan@firma.cz, /admin/audit all return 200 and contain the tag NB-0001 where the asset is listed; as employee (jan@firma.cz) GET / returns 200 and /admin/assets returns 403; GET /auth/login while anonymous returns 200 and contains 'Přihlásit'; unknown token GET /handovers/confirm/12345 as jan returns 410. At least 6 assertions across 3 test functions; no mocks; do not modify any other file. Compare page text with resp.get_data(as_text=True) (str), never with resp.data bytes — a bytes literal cannot contain non-ASCII characters such as 'Přihlásit' and the file would not parse.

uses.fixtures: tests/conftest.py: app, client, login(client, email), api(client, method, path, key=..., **kwargs), outbox(app)
